info.name: Khatma BE - Khatmas
info.description: Shared Quran/Zikr Khatma lifecycle and membership. Authenticated requests use the access token from the Auth collection. Protected routes return 401 without a valid bearer token; invalid bodies return 400.

item.name: Create Quran Khatma
item.description: Creates an active Quran Khatma and adds the current user as owner. Returns { id, name }.

item.name: Join Khatma by code
item.description: Joins an active Quran or Zikr Khatma. Repeated joins are idempotent. Invalid or inactive code returns 404.

item.name: List active Khatmas
item.description: Returns the current user's Khatmas filtered by type; active results include memberCount.

item.name: List completed Khatmas
item.description: Returns the current user's completed Khatmas with completedAt.

item.name: Read Khatma members
item.description: Members only. Returns userId, displayName, role, and joinedAt for each member. Non-member access returns 403; unknown id returns 404.

item.name: Read invite code
item.description: Members only. Returns { joinCode }. Non-member access returns 403; unknown id returns 404.
